what: Among several background layers attached behind the screen (shimmering light video · plain color · photo video), only the layer with the same name as the section on the 1% band at screen center turns on, with .4s cubic-bezier(.27,0,.58,1), and the rest turn off. With no section borderlines, the page changes clothes like a single sheet of paper. Even when leaving the band it keeps the last name. The tone (white·ink) of the section on the 1% band at the top of the screen is carried in the element’s data-tone, and the CSS that uses it for header text color switches accordingly.

options.[data-fx-part=stage]: Backplate fixed to the screen (holds the layers)
options.[data-fx-part=layer]: Layer — section names to turn on in data-key (several, space-separated, e.g: "plain footer")
options.[data-fx-part=zone]: Section — name in data-key, header bar shape in data-tone (if any). A section inside a section is allowed (the one crossing the strip wins)
options.line: Center band position (% from top of screen), default 50
options.base: Layer to turn on first, default is the first section name
options.--fx-dur · --fx-ease: Turn-on duration and curve (via style), default .4s · cubic-bezier(.27,0,.58,1)
options.fx:layer: Event the element fires when the layer changes (detail.key)
